text:
mika: morning team — Cascade private VPC dry-run tomorrow 08:00. Need a last-minute preflight: peering routes, NAT capacity, CMK grants, CloudTrail S3 sink + retention. tagging @joel @rachel @priya :wave:

joel: on it. I'll scope vpc peering + route table parity across prod and analytics.

rachel: I'll validate CloudTrail -> s3 bucket + default encryption. procurement asked for 7y retention, need to surface migration effort.

priya: KMS checks: key state, admin principals, rotation, and add cloudtrail principal if missing. Also capture key creation date.

joel: run I used to list peering/routes: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0caa11bb --query 'RouteTables[*].Routes'` — found analytics-rtb missing peer route to prod-cascade.

mika: please add that as a remediation step in the runbook and patch in staging.

joel: patch submitted: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0f1e2d3 --destination-cidr-block 10.50.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0d4e5f6` (chg-id chg-0f8e7d6c).

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0f8e7d6c) by joel at 2026-03-24T07:12:11Z

rachel: CloudTrail trail exists: cascade-audit. Bucket: cascade-audit-us-east-1. Bucket default encryption is AES256; not using KMS. I'll propose change to use `alias/cascade-audit-kms` and include a one-time re-encrypt job.

priya: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444455556666:key/aa22bb33 created 2024-12-01. Policy missing CloudTrail service principal. Sample to add: `{"Sid":"AllowCloudTrail","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`. Drafting PR.

joel: NATs: two NAT gateways in us-east-1. Analytics subnets were accidentally pointing at IGW; switched to NAT and queued smoke test. Also found sg-0c3d4e permissive egress on app-tier; tightening rules.

mika: thanks. Upload SG + NAT + route artifacts to gist so CS can attach to ticket.

joel: uploaded gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/cascade-net-snapshots (contains SG export, NAT list, route-table snapshots).

ops-bot: compliance-bot: KMS policy PR #4127 opened by priya (adds CloudTrail principal + audit role).

rachel: retention note: 7y requested. If we change bucket lifecycle to 7y and enable KMS, need cross-account replication considerations. I'll add to the SOW draft.

mika: renewal risk: procurement asked for HSM-backed keys; mark as medium until solutions provides cost delta and timeline. Tagging @solutions separately.

priya: perms sweep done in staging; added CloudTrail principal and rotation ON. Will push policy JSON to runbook.

joel: smoke tests passed after route and NAT fixes. Patching prod mirror after dry-run.

mika: perfect. I'll update the onboarding runbook, add renewal risk to customer health card (medium/HSM ask) and send the runbook to Cascade ops for acknowledgment. Dry-run start 08:00 tomorrow.

mika: final ask — drop any follow-up links here after dry-run. Closing this preflight. :thumbsup:
